title: Tunnellio random domain
summary: Managed Tunnellio runtime with a server-issued ephemeral domain. Only an API token is required; the setup script validates it against the server before saving.
operatorPrepares: Create an API token in the Tunnellio cabinet.
Paste it here. Nothing else is required.

notes.api_token: Validated live through POST /v1/meta during profile setup. An authenticated 'plan_required' answer still proves the token is real; only 401/invalid_token is rejected.
notes.runtime_name: Empty means the launcher derives a stable name from the workspace path.
